highlights_headline: Upcoming servicing fixes prevent stale outlines and invalid mask copies when font-scaler output changes between glyph loads.

bullets.lead: Mask-filtered glyphs respect reloaded image data
bullets.detail: Rasterizes the reloaded glyph's path and copies overlap only between compatible byte-per-pixel masks. Clipped embossed glyphs preserve full plane strides, preventing stale-path rendering, sub-byte buffer overwrites and corrupted or uncleared mask planes. Managed bindings are unchanged.
